name: Arcanum College Graduate
body:
You have completed the basic curriculum at the Arcanum College, though higher degrees of education are still available.

Benefit: Once a week you reroll a failed Spellcraft check, and can use the Spellcraft skill to earn money lecturing in the same way other characters can use Perform skills to earn money performing.

Convergent Paths: Students of Arcanum Archetypes Copyright 2013 Steven D. Russell; Author: Eric Morton
